unit_cn: Unit 4 Journey Across a Vast Land 穿越辽阔大地
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 4 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填(英美不同给 ipa_us);例句原创、火车之旅/地理风光/旅行见闻主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: In Montreal many people spoke English with a French accent.
words.example_cn: 在蒙特利尔,许多人说英语带着法语口音。

words.example_en: At the station all the signs and advertisements were in French.
words.example_cn: 在车站,所有的标识和广告都是法语的。

words.example_en: We took the train instead of a flight with any airline.
words.example_cn: 我们选择坐火车,而没有乘任何航空公司的航班。

words.example_en: We sat in a restaurant alongside the broad St Lawrence River.
words.example_cn: 我们坐在宽阔的圣劳伦斯河边的一家餐馆里。

words.example_en: The girls did not anticipate seeing such an open country.
words.example_cn: 姑娘们没有料到会看到这样一片开阔的国土。

words.meaning_cn: 古物;古董;古老的;古董的
words.example_en: They admired the antique furniture dating back to the 17th century.
words.example_cn: 他们欣赏着可追溯到17世纪的古董家具。

words.example_en: "Anyhow, the next station is my stop," Anna said.
words.example_cn: “不过,下一站就是我下车的地方,”安娜说。

words.example_en: Should a chance to travel arise, I would love to cross Canada by rail.
words.example_cn: 若有机会出行,我很想坐火车横穿加拿大。

words.example_en: The beauty of the lake took the visitors' breath away.
words.example_cn: 湖的美景令游客惊叹不已。

words.example_en: From the train they saw a bunch of farms covering a large area.
words.example_cn: 他们从火车上看到一片片占地很广的农场。

words.example_en: Her travel diary was clear and coherent from start to finish.
words.example_cn: 她的旅行日记从头到尾清晰而有条理。

words.example_en: Contrary to what many people believe, China has vast empty spaces.
words.example_cn: 与许多人的看法相反,中国有大片空旷之地。

words.example_en: Along St Paul Street we watched artists practising their craft.
words.example_cn: 在圣保罗街上,我们看着艺术家们施展手艺。

words.example_en: When they pulled back the curtain, they could see Lake Huron.
words.example_cn: 他们拉开窗帘时,便能看见休伦湖。

words.example_en: Workers had to drill through the rock to build the railway.
words.example_cn: 工人们必须钻穿岩石来修建这条铁路。

words.example_en: Their trip from Vancouver to Toronto had taken a duration of four days.
words.example_cn: 他们从温哥华到多伦多的旅程持续了四天。

words.example_en: They met Lin Fei around dusk over dinner downtown.
words.example_cn: 他们在黄昏时分于市中心共进晚餐,见到了林菲。

words.example_en: When Lake Louise freezes over in winter, people skate on it.
words.example_cn: 冬天路易斯湖结冰时,人们便在上面滑冰。

words.example_en: It was freezing cold on the prairie, with frost on the ground.
words.example_cn: 草原上极其寒冷,地面上结着霜。

words.example_en: There was frost on the ground, confirming that autumn had arrived.
words.example_cn: 地面上结着霜,证实秋天已经来临。

words.example_en: High in the Rockies, the travellers spotted wild mountain goats.
words.example_cn: 在落基山高处,旅行者看到了野生的山羊。

words.example_en: Vancouver has a fine harbour with mountains looking out over the city.
words.example_cn: 温哥华有一个良港,群山俯瞰着这座城市。

words.meaning_cn: 最精彩的部分;突出;强调
words.example_en: Seeing the Great Lakes was the highlight of their whole journey.
words.example_cn: 看到五大湖是他们整个旅程中最精彩的部分。

words.example_en: Anna taught them the idiom "as flat as a pancake".
words.example_cn: 安娜教他们“像煎饼一样平”这个习语。

words.example_en: The prairie was literally as flat as the eye could see.
words.example_cn: 那片草原简直平坦得一望无际。

words.example_en: Edmonton has one of the largest shopping malls in North America.
words.example_cn: 埃德蒙顿有北美最大的购物商场之一。

words.example_en: Canada is a massive country with vast and empty spaces.
words.example_cn: 加拿大是一个幅员辽阔、空旷无人的巨大国家。

words.example_en: They were astonished to see mist rising from the great falls.
words.example_cn: 他们惊讶地看到薄雾从大瀑布上升起。

words.example_en: Misty clouds hung over Niagara Falls in the early morning.
words.example_cn: 清晨,薄雾笼罩在尼亚加拉瀑布上空。

words.example_en: "You owe it to yourselves to stay in Montreal longer," he said.
words.example_cn: “你们应该让自己在蒙特利尔多待些日子,”他说。

words.example_en: Snow still covered the high peaks of the Canadian Rockies.
words.example_cn: 积雪仍覆盖着加拿大落基山脉的高峰。

words.example_en: A young photographer named Jean-Philippe sat down with them.
words.example_cn: 一位名叫让-菲利普的年轻摄影师在他们旁边坐下。

words.example_en: They must have spent a pleasant evening together at the party.
words.example_cn: 他们在聚会上一定度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

words.example_en: The train headed southeast across the great Canadian Prairie.
words.example_cn: 火车向东南方向驶过辽阔的加拿大大草原。

words.example_en: They had a few hours before they had to proceed to Montreal.
words.example_cn: 在必须继续前往蒙特利尔之前,他们还有几个小时。

words.example_en: Butchart Gardens was transformed from an old quarry.
words.example_cn: 布查特花园是由一座旧采石场改造而成的。

words.example_en: Seen from the top of the hill, the scenery was truly fascinating.
words.example_cn: 从山顶望去,那景色着实令人着迷。

words.example_en: From the CN Tower they looked across the shores of Lake Ontario.
words.example_cn: 他们从加拿大国家电视塔上眺望安大略湖的湖岸。

words.meaning_cn: 壮观的;壮丽的;壮丽的场面
words.example_en: The Rocky Mountains offered the most spectacular views of the trip.
words.example_cn: 落基山脉呈现出这趟旅程中最壮观的景色。

words.example_en: The girls saw hundreds of skyscrapers of glass and steel.
words.example_cn: 姑娘们看到了数百座玻璃和钢铁建成的摩天大楼。

words.meaning_cn: 轰隆隆地响(移动);打雷;雷声
words.example_en: The train thundered on through the rolling hills of Ontario.
words.example_cn: 火车轰隆隆地驶过安大略起伏的丘陵。

words.meaning_cn: 烤面包片;干杯;为……干杯;烤
words.example_en: In Montreal they loved good coffee, toast, and cheese.
words.example_cn: 在蒙特利尔,他们喜爱香浓的咖啡、吐司和奶酪。

words.example_en: After the prairie they were back in an urban area, the city of Winnipeg.
words.example_cn: 穿过草原后,他们又回到了城市,即温尼伯市。

words.example_en: After another day on the train, they eventually reached Winnipeg.
words.example_cn: 在火车上又过了一天后,他们最终抵达了温尼伯。

words.example_en: Toronto is the largest and wealthiest city in Canada.
words.example_cn: 多伦多是加拿大最大、最富裕的城市。

words.example_en: Downtown Toronto is full of tall glass skyscrapers.
words.example_cn: 多伦多市中心满是高高的玻璃摩天大楼。
